title: Audit log entry (outbound)
description: Source: core/audit/src/main/java/com/agenticai/core/audit/dto/AuditLogEntryResponse.java, read directly (2026-07-19) - a Java record, fields listed in declaration order. AuditOutcome enum values inlined from core/audit/AuditOutcome.java (read directly, same date). This is what GET /api/audit/** actually returns (AuditLogEntryResponse.from(AuditLogEntry)), not the JPA entity behind it.

outcome.description: AuditOutcome is deliberately more granular than success/failure - PENDING_APPROVAL/AUTO_APPROVED/APPROVED/REJECTED are themselves meaningful compliance states for anything gated by HumanApprovalGateService, per that enum's own javadoc. DENIED/EXPIRED/REPLAYED/BUDGET_EXCEEDED/WARNING are the Agent SDK's audit vocabulary, added to core's enum (2026-10-16) so SDK and core records share one schema; core/app AuditOutcomeAlignmentTest pins this list to core's enum and both Agent SDKs.

detail.description: Record field has no explicit nullability annotation checked here - schema treats it as nullable since Jackson will serialize a null detail as JSON null, not omit the key, for a record component.
